_comment: Per-package mypy error count baselines. CI fails when a package's count grows beyond its baseline (regression). Baselines were captured 2026-05-10 with mypy --ignore-missing-imports against the package source dirs. To update after intentionally fixing errors, run scripts/mypy-count.sh and write the new lower number here. Do not raise these numbers — that defeats the purpose. New code must not introduce new errors.
